title: Panoptes config
description: Config file for the panoptes host agent (config.toml). Command-line options override it.

port.description: Serial port of the board, e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM5. Default: auto-detect.

baud.description: Serial baud rate. The firmware speaks 115200.

verbose.description: Debug logging (device boot messages, frame sizes).

log_file.description: Also write the log to this file.

bright.description: Backlight level, 0-255. Used when auto_bright is off.

auto_bright.description: Set the backlight from the board's light sensor.

auto_bright_min.description: Lowest backlight level auto_bright will go to in a dark room, 0-255.

night_bright.description: Backlight level while night mode is on (long-press the screen to toggle it), 0-255.

led.description: RGB status LED that follows CPU load.

led_bright.description: Maximum brightness of the status LED, 0-255. The LED is very bright; the default keeps it subtle.

beep.description: Speaker beep when an alert fires.

page.description: Force this page (0 dashboard, 1 CPU, 2 network, 3 sensors, 4 system). -1 leaves the board alone.

cycle.description: Advance to the next page every N seconds. 0 = off.

alert_temp.description: CPU temperature in °C above which the alert banner shows.

alert_cpu.description: CPU load in % above which the alert banner shows.

theme.description: Colour theme. Each has a dark and a light variant; theme_mode picks which one shows.

theme_mode.description: Which variant of the theme to show. auto follows the room light (the board's light sensor).

hello_interval.description: Seconds between `hello` messages while waiting for the board to answer.

reconnect_interval.description: Seconds between attempts to find and open the board after an error or unplug.

handshake_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for `hi` before trying the next candidate port.

net_interface.description: Network interface to graph, e.g. enp5s0 or Wi-Fi. Default: the default-route interface.

usb_ids.description: Extra USB vendor:product IDs (hex, e.g. "0403:6001") to treat as the board when auto-detecting, for boards with a USB-serial chip other than CH340, CH9102 or CP210x. They are tried first.

mounts.description: Mount points (or Windows drive letters) to show on the disk widget, at most 4. Default: pick the real filesystems automatically.

disable.description: Metric groups not to collect or send; the board hides their widgets.
